generate_chat_completion: generate a chat completion by sending messages to an Ollama model with streaming support
generate_completion: generate a text completion from an Ollama model with optional system prompt and template
get_ollama_models: list all available Ollama models across configured backend instances
pull_ollama_model: pull and download an Ollama model from a model registry to a backend instance
download_ollama_model: download a model file from HuggingFace or GitHub and register it with Ollama
